title: Use only licensed boats to fish in the Torres Strait
what: A person must not have an unlicensed boat equipped for taking fish in an area of Australian jurisdiction under the Torres Strait Fisheries Act.

sources.title: Torres Strait Fisheries Act 1984
sources.quote: 51 Having boat equipped for fishing—general (1) A person shall not, in an area of Australian jurisdiction, have in his or her possession or under his or her control, an unlicensed boat equipped for taking fish.
